correctness.rationale: Order identities and adjacent-gap ratio prove every compact omega-limit set lies in one coordinate-equality plane or diagonal. Logistic bounds and mutation produce uniform interior persistence. On the equality plane the explicit 1/(uv) Dulac divergence is strictly negative; finite equilibria and no closed connections imply a compact internally chain transitive limit is a singleton. The case a=1 is explicitly solvable. Algebraic elimination enumerates equilibria and factored 3x3 Jacobian yields the exact hyperbolic sink/saddle classification; verify.py checked 348 exact rational identities/inequalities. Finite checks are not substituted for proof of global convergence.

value.rationale: The founding model distinguishes stable equilibria from persistent oscillations; a global convergence theorem on a natural exact symmetry slice is a structural gap, stronger than local spectra and sample simulations, and rules out all nonfixed compact recurrence at positive mutation. It also identifies an open parameter interval with four coexisting attracting compositions, provides sharp endpoints, and explains why such multiplicity does not imply sustained cycling.
